en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude going silent in a thread when its channel becomes shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces mid-task; it now posts a one-time note to @-mention it in a new thread
zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了任务进行中 channel 在 Enterprise Grid 工作区之间变为共享时，Claude 在 thread 中不再响应的问题；现在它会发布一条一次性提示，请在新 thread 中 @ 提及它
